name: Repo & org settings
tagline: Settings for a repository or organisation
summary: Settings pages for a repository (general, branches and rules, collaborators and teams, webhooks, Actions secrets and variables, labels) and for an organisation (profile, members, teams).

flow.label: Settings layout route
flow.note: Prefetches the overview and the viewer's permission, then wraps the child page in the frame.

flow.label: RepoSettingsGate
flow.note: Shows a page only if the viewer's role allows it: admin, or triage and above for labels.

flow.label: SettingsReadView
flow.note: Draws the loaded data, a not-available notice with a link to GitHub, or a retry button.

flow.label: useSettingsAction
flow.note: Runs a save or delete, shows pending, done or the error, then invalidates the affected queries.

flow.label: runSettingsMutation
flow.note: Calls GitHub with the user's token and turns a failure into a readable message.

flow.label: GitHub REST
flow.note: Repos, collaborators, teams, hooks, Actions secrets and variables, labels and orgs endpoints.

features.name: General settings
features.summary: Name, description, website, default branch, feature and merge switches behind a save bar, plus visibility, archive and delete behind confirm dialogs.

entry.role: Only place field names become API names

features.name: Branches and rules
features.summary: A read-only list of rulesets and branch protection rules described in plain words, with a link to edit them on github.com.

entry.role: Turns a rule into a short phrase

features.name: Collaborators and teams
features.summary: Add people or teams with a role, change roles, remove them, and cancel pending invitations after an inline confirmation.

entry.role: Add a person or change a role

features.name: Webhooks page
features.summary: Create, edit and delete webhooks, choose their events, see recent deliveries and redeliver one.

features.name: Actions secrets and variables
features.summary: Secrets are write-only. Sealing means encrypting the value to the repo's public key (a libsodium sealed box), which GitHub requires before storing it.

entry.role: Sealed box with WebCrypto and noble

features.name: Labels page
features.summary: Create, rename, recolour and delete labels. Open to triage access and above, unlike the other pages, which need admin.

entry.role: Role to what the viewer may open

features.name: Organisation settings
features.summary: Profile and member privileges, members and invitations, teams and their members. Members who are not owners get a read-only view.

entry.role: Org settings shell and member check

entryPoints.role: Repo settings layout; child pages are in settings/

goodParts: Each settings domain is a pure module with its own test in lib/settings (9 test files); seal.test.ts checks only the repository key opens the box.
e2e runs real writes against the emulator: isolated/repo-settings.spec.ts (8 tests), org-settings.spec.ts and org-settings-member.spec.ts.
watch: Branches and rules is read-only, and it loads at most 20 rulesets and 20 protected branches, one detail request each (lib/github/settings-rules.ts:14).
A secret's plain value is posted to the DiffKit server function and sealed there, not in the browser (lib/github/settings-actions.ts:52).
Largest files: webhooks-settings.tsx 521 lines, org-teams-settings.tsx 469, access-settings.tsx 408.
